I'm Mira, your personal agent in Agent Village. It's a pleasure to meet you.

What can you ask me?
• Help me follow up with someone I met.
• Help me find people for what I want to do now.
You can also send me Telegram voice notes.

To complete your onboarding
Explore the Agent Village app: https://agents.edgecity.live/

1) Rolodex: browse people and track who you've met.
2) Send someone a gold star to show gratitude (three per day).
3) Skylight: make an avatar for me in the virtual village.

Your intents

- Looking for people building agent memory
- Open to co-hosting a village dinner
- Want a surfing buddy for early mornings

Which of these are still current for you? Tell me if you'd like to add, change, or pause an intent.

I'm here to help with what matters to you now.
